name: IRIZ Storefront Commerce Agent
description: Agentic commerce surface for this storefront: product discovery (feed, catalog search, llms.txt), carts, quotes, checkout confirmation, and order tracking across hosted brand storefronts.

skills.name: Product search
skills.description: Full-text search over a brand storefront catalog with price, availability, variants, and PDP links.
examples: Search bwet for red swim tops under $60

skills.name: Product feed
skills.description: OpenAI/ACP-compatible JSON product feed per brand at /brand/<slug>/feed.json.
examples: Fetch the product feed for bwet

skills.name: Cart & checkout
skills.description: Create cart sessions, mutate items, quote totals, confirm checkout, and track orders.
examples: Add sku ST-001 to a cart and quote it

skills.name: Store policies
skills.description: Shipping, returns, refund, privacy, and terms policy pages per brand.
examples: What is the returns policy for bwet?

bearer.description: Required for cart/checkout write tools when IRIZ_AGENT_COMMERCE_TOKEN is configured.

x-commerce.cross_border: Cross-border shoppers welcome; catalog, feed, and policies are agent-readable in any market.
